action: Call Carlos Ruiz back — he reached out and I owe him the return. This is not a mentorship call and I will not frame it that way. I ask him what his cert training actually cost, how far along he is, whether the EV modules exist in the Millfield CC program or whether he went somewhere else for that specialization, and whether he has any names yet of fleet operators or RoboRide-adjacent employers who are actually going to be hiring in the next 6 months. I also tell him where I am honestly: no savings, gig work keeping the lights on, cert at month 5. I am not performing stability. I am talking to someone who is ahead of me on the same road and I need real information.
